svg.title: For any ordered list of distinct unresolved nonsingleton groups, successive shell resolutions have bound proportional to Q j 2−njγ. Absolute Fubini gives the multiple sum and its equality with the original pairing in every permitted order. Only the combined subtraction expressions are asserted absolutely summable; this does not separately assert it for their Taylor monomials. For desired loss ε > 0, choose γ = min(1, ε)/(τQ + 1). Then the economy condition holds, εQ ≤ε, and on unrestricted shells monotonicity of R−ε for 0 < R ≤1 gives the requested loss using the same devices and projections.
